prompts.title: Modern Utility
prompts.prompt:
Create a premium high-fashion workwear magazine cover in a vertical 4:5 editorial poster format.
A stylish male subject walks confidently toward the camera in a full-body runway-style pose, centered in the frame. His body is slightly in motion, one foot stepping forward, right hand casually inside the trouser pocket, left hand relaxed beside the body. His expression is calm, serious, and fashion-editorial. He wears narrow black sunglasses, slightly tousled dark hair, and a subtle layered silver chain necklace.

Outfit
Oversized dark charcoal / black workwear jacket, worn open
Clean white crewneck sweatshirt with a small square heritage-style logo patch on the left chest
Loose dark charcoal wide-leg pleated trousers with natural drape and folds
Chunky polished black leather shoes
Overall styling should feel minimal, utilitarian, premium, and street-luxury

Scene & Lighting
Set the subject in a dark grey studio environment with a smooth seamless backdrop and slightly reflective floor. Use soft directional studio lighting from the front-left, creating realistic shadows on the floor and adding depth to the clothing. The image should have a muted monochrome palette with crisp contrast, clean skin tones, and high-end fashion campaign quality.

Composition
Full-body framing, subject vertically centered
Slightly low, straight-on editorial camera angle
Subject overlaps the background typography naturally
Clean negative space around the upper and side areas for text
Premium magazine-cover balance and hierarchy

Typography & Graphic Layout
Design the image like a bold fashion magazine poster cover:
At the very top, oversized bold white text: “WIP”
Small condensed white text at the top-right: “HOMME”
Behind the subject, huge dark semi-transparent text spanning the width: “CARHARTT”
On the right-middle side, large bold white number: “01”
On the lower-left side, four small editorial text blocks with bold headings and short subtext, laid out like magazine cover blurbs
Bottom-right corner, very large condensed white headline: “FASHION”

Visual Style
Ultra-realistic fashion editorial photography, luxury streetwear campaign, magazine-cover graphic design, crisp fabric details, natural garment folds, sharp typography integration, professional studio shadows, premium workwear aesthetic, clean commercial retouching, high contrast, sophisticated and modern.

Use the uploaded image as a strict identity reference. The subject’s facial structure, proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, and natural features must remain 100% identical. No beautification, no stylization, no identity drift.

Jawline structure and sharpness
Natural skin texture with visible pores (no plastic smoothing)
Eye shape, spacing, and gaze direction
Nose proportions and facial symmetry
Hair: soft, slightly tousled, natural volume with realistic texture (not overly styled)

Neutral lips, subtle intensity
Eyes looking off-camera to the right

Standing upright, close to a wall
Body slightly angled to the left (~10–15°)
Head turned to the right (~40–45°), forming a clean three-quarter profile

Both hands positioned at the lower front of the jacket
Fingers gently holding and adjusting the middle button area
Gesture is natural, not posed — looks like mid-adjustment
Elbows slightly bent, relaxed but structured
Overall posture:

Clean, controlled, editorial stance
No exaggerated posing — minimal, refined movement

Suit: dark navy blue (#151821), muted and matte, not overly glossy or saturated
Fabric: modern, smooth, slightly soft texture (not heavy luxury shine)
Fit: slim, modern tailoring with clean structure
Shirt: crisp white, structured collar

Overall palette is controlled, and editorial.

Head and shoulders overlapping background typography (important layering effect)
Background & Typography (Critical Fix)

Large serif typography “MADE” behind subject

Color: White

Wide letter spacing
Subject partially covers letters → creates depth like a magazine cover
Depth & Spatial Detail
Subject positioned very close to background
Minimal depth separation
Clean editorial flatness with subtle realism

Key light:

Front-right (his left), 45° angle
Soft highlights on face and suit
Fill light:

Gentle front-left fill to retain facial detail
Shadow behavior:

Soft shadow cast on wall (viewer’s left side)
Shadow follows head + shoulder silhouette naturally
No harsh contrast, no dramatic lighting — keep it refined and editorial
Camera & Image Quality
85mm portrait lens
Eye-level camera
Aperture: f/2.8
Sharp subject, slightly softened background
Ultra-high resolution (8K)
Hyper-realistic detail
Natural skin texture
Crisp fabric rendering

prompts.title: Umber & Onyx
prompts.prompt:
Create a full-body cinematic studio portrait of a stylish man with a refined, confident aura. Use the attached reference image for precise facial identity matching. Preserve the exact facial structure and likeness, including the same jawline definition, cheekbone structure, eyebrow shape, nose proportions, lip shape, beard density (if present), haircut length and styling, and natural skin tone. He is wearing a tailored, slim-fit chocolate-brown two-piece buttoned suit over a black ribbed turtleneck sweater, accented by a crisp white pocket square. Black belt. A delicate gold curb chain necklace rests over the turtleneck, complemented by rimless gold-framed spectacles and a luxury gold wristwatch with a leather strap. He is shod in highly polished, mirror-finish black patent leather oxfords with black socks.

Pose & Expression: He stands in a relaxed yet commanding "power lean" with his legs crossed at the ankles. One hand is tucked into his trouser pocket, while the other lightly adjusts the lapel of his blazer. His expression is calm and stoic, with a sharp jawline, looking off-camera to the right in a contemplative profile view.
Composition & Camera Angle: A full-body vertical composition shot at eye-level. The subject is centred, creating a strong vertical line against the minimalist backdrop.
Background: A smooth, seamless, dark grey matte studio backdrop, infinity curve, zero texture, no visible corners, with a subtle vignette effect to draw focus toward the subject. The floor is a matching dark grey, creating a "limitless" void effect.
In the upper frame, behind the subject, place a very large white coloured text "MAGAZINE". The typography features a bold, high-contrast serif font that is vertically elongated by 20-30% to create a sleek, compressed editorial aesthetic.
Lighting: Professional three-point studio lighting. A soft key light from the upper left creates gentle highlights on his face and the texture of the suit fabric, while a subtle rim light separates his silhouette from the dark background. Soft, diffused shadows emphasize the tailoring of the clothes.
Technical Details: Photorealistic, 8k resolution, shot on a Sony A7R IV with an 85mm f/1.8 lens for sharp focus and compression. Visible fabric textures (wool blend of the suit, fine knit of the turtleneck), realistic skin pores, and crisp reflections on the glasses and shoes. Aspect ratio 4:5.
